The '''Trenwyth system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Stensen sector/Legends|Stensen sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Trenwyth/Legends|Trenwyth]].
